top_choice_rationale: P001 (Crews, Deshaies, Handa) credits one design principle, recruiting an E3 ligase to a chosen protein so that it is removed rather than inhibited, through PROTACs and the cereblon mechanism of thalidomide-type glues. The principle is supported by ternary-complex structures, has been reproduced widely, and has changed what chemists and clinicians can do; the allocation is the one most members back. P002 (Crews, Deshaies, Ciulli) is a coherent PROTAC-only fallback but omits the cereblon mechanism behind the best-established degrader class. P003 (ionizable lipid nanoparticles) is mature but has a hard seat cut and overlaps Medicine 2023. Any award is preferable to none.
